name: 入力と候補質問をまとめる施設の調べ方
prompt: Create one finished compact Japanese Lighthouse component matching the supplied Japanese mock's wording and two-row arrangement, using the original reference for icon anatomy and visible states. Pure #FFFFFF canvas and surfaces. This is combined question input plus suggested questions. Exact title '施設について質問', Meiryo Bold20/28 role. Restore the ORIGINAL THREE four-point sparkles (one large low-left, small upper, medium right) inside the subtle pale green circle; the mock's single outlined star is incorrect. Green sparkles, no pink or red. Beneath title, complete white rectangular input, thin neutral outline, modest 4px radius, full boundary never clipped. Placeholder exact '口コミには何と書かれていますか', Meiryo Regular14/24 gray #6E6E6E. At right a small forest-green circular submit control, original white rightward arrow WITH horizontal shaft and chevron head; no chevron-only glyph. Green primary #174C36→#1F6444→#2D8F5E 135deg subtle. Below input two separate white outlined unselected pill suggestions, each on its own row at left, exact 'どのような料理がありますか' and '店内はどのような雰囲気ですか'. Body Meiryo Regular14/24, never bold pills or placeholder. Neutral thin outlines #D9DEE3, dark ink #1D1D1D, no gray-filled or mint-filled pills. Preserve compact natural spacing and readable hierarchy, enough bottom space to keep second pill complete. No added heading/chrome/icons/content; no card shadows; standalone component tightly framed. Retain three sparkles and the source arrow anatomy exactly.
reviewNotes: Combined component visually reviewed: all Japanese text complete, heading/body hierarchy, three four-point sparkles, shafted right arrow, white outlined complete input, two neutral unselected pill rows. Existing LH01-0071/0072 separate proofs reused; combined geometry checked. No protected photographic media. Raster candidate only; exact font face and runtime interactions unverified, no owner approval.
